key_insight: The study developed an affordable, locally fabricated water welding machine that leverages seawater-based electrolysis to support sustainable entrepreneurship in rural communities.
engineering_relevance: It demonstrates a practical machine-design approach that combines accessible materials, functional validation, and entrepreneurship-focused evaluation for low-cost welding technology.
method: Used an R&D method with a descriptive-developmental design
Followed a design-to-testing workflow: conceptualization, fabrication, testing, validation, and evaluation
Collected expert, instructor, and student ratings using validated questionnaires
evidence_signal: Evaluation from 138 respondents showed very high ratings for functionality, TAM acceptance, and entrepreneurial potential, with mean scores around 4.55 to 4.56.
watch_item: The abstract does not report detailed ANOVA outcomes or long-term field durability, so real-world performance and scalability still need further verification.
paper_title: INNOVATED WATER WELDING MACHINE FOR ENTREPRENEURSHIP
